ns2:course.label: Basic Photography
ns2:course.description: Investigates basic image making and meaning. Student works with digital camera, exposure meter and learns digital printing. Student must furnish camera. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. Prerequisite: Restricted to Art and Design majors or minors.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. Prerequisite: Restricted to Art and Design majors or minors.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: A student registered in one or more Art & Design course(s) exhibiting this message, will be assessed a $95 facility use fee once each term.
